data.title: Professors urge quake safeguards
data.description: <p>Thammasat University academics have called for greater resilience and better disaster response as earthquake and climate risks rise.</p>

data.title: Co-payment  scheme in final stretch
data.description: <p>The government has urged beneficiaries of the "Thais Help Thais Plus" co-payment scheme to use their remaining entitlements before the programme ends, as cumulative spending has surged to more than 138 billion baht and generated income for nearly 1.2 million participating businesses.</p>

data.title: New water treatment model helps  700 families after Kok metal scare
data.description: <p>A science-based water treatment project is helping communities along Chiang Rai's Kok River cope with heavy-metal contamination.</p>

data.title: Anutin shrugs off debate threats
data.description: <p>Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has dismissed concerns that opposition MPs will use the upcoming budget debate to attack the government, saying parliamentary scrutiny is part of MPs' rights and responsibilities.</p>

data.title: US carrier visit highlights security ties
data.description: <p>The arrival of the USS Abraham Lincoln aircraft carrier and more than 5,000 US personnel in Pattaya highlights both the strengthening of Thai-US security ties and complex geopolitical dynamics in the region, according to experts.</p>

data.title: Pakorn calls for reform of sluggish bureaucracy
data.description: <p>Deputy Prime Minister Pakorn Nilprapunt has called for an overhaul of the country's bureaucracy, focusing on efficiency rather than "bureaucratic reform".</p>

data.title: Prince William to represent King Charles III at Norway late King Harald's funeral
data.description: LONDON - Britain's Prince William will attend the funeral of Norway's late King Harald next week in place of his father King Charles III, Buckingham Palace said on Saturday.

data.title: US envoy says Israel has responsibility for Palestinians
data.description: TURMUS AYYA, Palestinian Territories - The US ambassador to Israel said on Saturday that the Israeli government bore responsibility for West Bank Palestinians’ safety and should impose “severe consequences” over violence, as he visited families after a surge in settler attacks.

data.title: Commemoration held for Serbian war criminal Mladic
data.description: BELGRADE - A commemoration was held on Saturday in Belgrade for war criminal Ratko Mladic two days ahead of his burial, attended by dozens of former military personnel, family members and officials.

data.title: Pakorn calls for more efficient civil service
data.description: Deputy Prime Minister Pakorn Nilprapunt has called for an overhaul of the country’s civil service, focusing on efficiency rather than “bureaucratic reform”.

data.title: Troops seize 1m speed pills after clash in Chiang Mai
data.description: More than 1 million speed pills were seized following a brief armed clash with suspected drug smugglers in Chiang Dao district of Chiang Mai on Saturday.

data.title: Russia hits Kyiv airports as Trump envoys awaited
data.description: KYIV - Russian strikes hit Kyiv’s airports overnight, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said on Saturday, as US envoys arrived in Moscow to discuss a plan to end more than four years of war.

data.title: Global autonomous weapons pact taking shape
data.description: GENEVA - The ⁠128 ⁠states party to ​a framework that regulates or bans weapons considered as indiscriminate, ​or causing too many ‌injuries, have agreed on a document that could pave the way to international rules on autonomous weapons.

data.title: Masked anti-migrant protesters shut down UK port
data.description: Dozens of masked people reportedly protesting against Channel migrant crossings blocked access to the Port of Dover in southern England on Saturday, halting traffic that is ferried between France and the UK.

data.title: Nepal tunnel rescue revives hope 10 days after flood
data.description: KATHMANDU - Rescuers in Nepal pulled a Chinese man out alive on Saturday from a tunnel buried by debris, as emergency response teams dug with new vigour in the search for missing people 10 days after catastrophic flooding.

data.title: Robert Pattinson a revelation in paedophile thriller
data.description: VENICE - British star Robert Pattinson will look to extend his stellar 2026 box office run by playing a creepy paedophile-hunting TV presenter in “Primetime”, which premieres at the Venice Film Festival on Saturday.

data.title: Child-sex broker linked to 50 victims arrested in Samut Prakan
data.description: Police have arrested a 38-year-old man accused of running an online network that recruited girls under 18 for prostitution, with investigators linking him to more than 50 victims.

data.title: Israeli man first target of new Thai deportation rules
data.description: An Israeli man convicted last month of making threats against the owners of a zoo on Koh Samui has become the first foreigner ordered out of Thailand under new rules governing deportation.

data.title: ONE Championship: Stamp Fairtex eyes Chihiro Sawada for MMA return after Flores win
data.description: Stamp Fairtex is targeting an MMA return in early 2027 after beating Selina Flores at ONE Fight Night 47 – with Chihiro Sawada and Itsuki Hirata among the opponents she would welcome.

data.title: SET Eases IPO Rules to Attract New Economy and Overseas Listings
data.description: The Stock Exchange of Thailand overhauls its IPO and secondary listing framework to attract foreign firms and modernise its 30-year-old market structure

data.title: More orangutans rescued from Indonesian wildfire
data.description: JAKARTA - An orangutan mother and her baby, threatened by encroaching wildfires to their habitat in Indonesia, were rescued earlier this week, authorities said on Saturday.

data.title: The poet, the grave and the grocer: an Icelandic mystery
data.description: THINGVELLIR, Iceland - In a small enclosure of lava stones in a grassy field, a modest tombstone bears the name of an Icelandic legend: Jonas Hallgrimsson. But are the bones beneath it really those of the poet, or a Danish grocer?

data.title: Haze from Indonesian fires spreading again
data.description: JAKARTA - Thick smog has blanketed parts of Indonesia as the vast archipelago battles to contain fires that have burned large swathes of Borneo and Sumatra.

data.title: Bolivian army base blasts kill two, wound dozens
data.description: VIACHA, Bolivia - Two explosions at an army barracks in Bolivia killed at least two people and wounded 81 on Friday, authorities said.

data.title: Torrential downpour alerts for 24 provinces
data.description: Flash floods and inundation are expected across the North, Northeast and East of Thailand through Tuesday, according to the Office of National Water Resources.
